candidates.explanation: The link in the new-email verification mail is built with the path '/confirm-email', the same page the sign-up activation mail (userSignUp) uses. The frontend page for '/confirm-email' calls the confirmEmail endpoint (POST auth/email/confirm). That endpoint expects a hash with a confirmEmailUserId and no newEmail. The new-email hash is never sent to confirmNewEmail (POST auth/email/confirm/new), so the email change is never applied.

fix.description: In confirmNewEmail, build the URL with the '/confirm-new-email' path instead of '/confirm-email'. The frontend page there should call the auth/email/confirm/new endpoint.
